title: SugarCraft — SugarTesting
description: SugarTesting: Test harness for SugarCraft programs — ProgramSimulator, scripted input, golden/snapshot assertions, VHS tape building, and graphics-stream decoding.
ogDescription: ProgramSimulator drives a Program with scripted input; captures model/view/cmds. Assertions provides assertGoldenAnsi, assertCellGrid, assertAnsiEquals, assertViewIdempotent. TapeRecorder emits VHS .tape files.
